license.excludes: Text quoted from others is not ours to license: the publisher's registry title, description and status message, quotes from the publisher's website (pricing), deprecation messages from npm or PyPI, the registry status message of a removed server and the status messages in the registry status changes of /changes (statusChanged), GitHub release names and release notes in registryChange, statements quoted from a repository's security policy, the tool descriptions in toolFacts (each is the publisher's first sentence), and tool, resource and package names.

current.base: entries in the registry list of 2026-11-02
current.label: today's records: entries with at least one of the first report's five mismatches between the registry listing and npm, PyPI or GitHub

firstReport.base: entries in the registry list of 2026-10-04
firstReport.label: first report: entries with at least one of the first report's five mismatches between the registry listing and npm, PyPI or GitHub

mismatchShare.note: Two different measurements, never one figure: `current` moves with each daily load and is quoted as '<pct>% of <of> entries (counted <countedAt>)'; `firstReport` is frozen and is quoted only with its registry snapshot date.
